blocks.text: Computing affects the environment and society in many ways. Technology can consume energy, produce electronic waste, and contribute to pollution. At the same time, technology influences social behavior, communication, and culture. Understanding environmental and social impacts helps promote responsible use of digital tools. Sustainable practices and awareness of societal effects are important for balancing technology with nature and communities.
